caption: WER during fine-tuning Whisper model with different types of fine-tunning
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the WER during Whisper fine-tuning, specifically for "type = full," representing two different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "epoch" and employs a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with numeric tick labels regularly spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks displayed from 20 to 28 at an interval of 2. The line representing "tiny full" is a grey dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers; it begins at its highest point of approximately 28.8 at epoch 0, decreases to roughly 27.3 at epoch 1 and 26.9 at epoch 2, experiences a steep decline to 24.1 at epoch 3, stabilizes slightly to 24.0 at epoch 4, and concludes with a gradual decrease to end at approximately 22.9 at epoch 6. The line denoting "base full" is a blue dotted line with upward-pointing triangle markers, starting at roughly 21.9 at epoch 0, declining to 20.9 at epoch 1, rising to a minor peak of 21.3 at epoch 2, and then following a continuous downward trend through the remaining epochs to finish at approximately 19.0 at epoch 6.
